verdict.rationale: Fenwick runs a public Startup Resource Center on its own site. It offers articles, videos, checklists and presentations from formation through financing to exit, including an Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview and a Top 10 Legal Issues guide covering equity vesting. The specific guides sit on a 'form' page, so access may be gated, which tempers how 'open' the knowledge base is. Missing for 10: confirmation the guides are freely accessible without a form or sign-up, evidence of FAQ-style or plain-language explainers, deeper equity/financing explainer coverage, independent corroboration.
